name: @zydraxyl/dracondex-sdb
description: DraconDex central SQLite schema — the one source both the Electron and Flutter apps generate their vault DDL from

scripts.generate: node schema/generate.mjs && node supabase/setup/gen.mjs && node tools/build-manifest.mjs
